record.description: Linear CC/CV charger for TWO series Li-ion / Li-polymer cells with integrated pass transistor, current sense, reverse-discharge protection and a 13 V input over-voltage cut-off; charge current set by one resistor on PROG (130 mA to 1.1 A); regulation voltage fixed per suffix (8.20 / 8.40 / 8.70 / 8.80 V). p.1 title verbatim: 'MCP73213 Dual-Cell Li-Ion/Li-Polymer Battery Charge Management Controller with Input Overvoltage Protection'.
record.description_quote: MCP73213 Dual-Cell Li-Ion/Li-Polymer Battery Charge Management Controller with Input Overvoltage Protection

record.rails_why: the chip is powered from the charging INPUT (VDD, 4–16 V range), not from a logic rail.
absolute_max_quotes: All Inputs and Outputs w.r.t. VSS .....-0.3 to (VDD+0.3)V
Maximum Junction Temperature, TJ . Internally Limited

supplies.name: VDD
supplies.cite: p.5 DC CHARACTERISTICS 'Supply Input': 'Input Voltage Range VDD 4 — 16 V' and 'Operating Supply Voltage VDD 4.2 — 13 V'. The OPERATING window (4.2–13 V) is carried as v_min/v_max; the 4–16 V 'Input Voltage Range' is the survivable-input window and the OVP row 'OVP Start Threshold VOVP 12.8 13 13.2 V' is where charging stops. TYP cell is '—' — v_typ null by observation. A 5 V USB input clears the UVLO 'UVLO Start Threshold VSTART 4.10 4.15 4.25 V' but note: an 8.4 V regulation needs VDD ≥ VREG + headroom — the table header conditions all limits on 'VDD= [VREG(Typical) + 0.3V] to 12V', i.e. ≥ 8.7 V for the 8.40 V member. 5 V USB CANNOT charge a 2S pack through this linear part.

current_mA.rail_basis: drawn from the charging input VDD.
current_mA.typical_basis: p.5 'Supply Current ISS' row, CHARGING condition verbatim: '— 700 1500 μA Charging' — 700 µA typ is the chip's own quiescent draw while charging; it EXCLUDES the charge current delivered to the pack (up to 1.1 A, see charge_current).
current_mA.peak_basis: same row MAX 1500 µA — steady-state maximum quiescent, not a transient; the pack current is separate.
current_mA.sleep_basis: same table, shutdown row verbatim: 'Supply Current ISS — 4 5.5 μA Shutdown (VDD ≤ VBAT – 150 mV)' — 4 µA typ.
current_mA.excludes: the charge current into VBAT (130 mA – 1.1 A by PROG), the STAT LED current
caveats: Quiescent only. The input must ALSO supply IREG to the pack: at 1 A into 8.4 V from a 9 V input the pass element dissipates ~0.6 W in a 3x3 DFN — the sheet's thermal figure is 'Thermal Resistance, DFN-10LD JA — 62 — °C/W' (4-layer JC51-7 board), so the current a real board can sustain is a thermal question the sheet leaves to the layout.
current_mA.cite: p.5 DC CHARACTERISTICS, 'Supply Current ISS' rows; p.8 thermal table.
current_mA.quote: Supply Current ISS — 4 5.5 μA Shutdown (VDD ≤ VBAT – 150 mV)

charge_current.quote: Fast Charge Current IREG 130 — 1100 mA TA = –5°C to +55°C
charge_current.cite: p.6 DC CHARACTERISTICS 'Current Regulation (Fast Charge, Constant-Current Mode)': IREG 130–1100 mA; 'PROG = 10 k' gives 117/130/143 mA and 'PROG = 1.1 k' gives 900/1000/1100 mA. The kΩ symbol is dropped by the extraction ('1.1 k').

regulation_voltage.quote: Regulated Output Voltage VREG 8.15 8.20 8.25 V TA= –5°C to +55°C
regulation_voltage.cite: p.5 'Voltage Regulation (Constant Voltage Mode)' rows 8.15/8.20/8.25, 8.35/8.40/8.45, 8.65/8.70/8.75, 8.75/8.80/8.85 V; p.2 device table row 'MCP73213-A6S/MF 8.40V 13V ...' (columns: part, VREG, OVP, precondition threshold... as the p.2 header prints) and 'MCP73213-B6S/MF 8.20V ...'. FOR A 2 x 4.2 V CELL PACK THE MEMBER IS -A6S/MF (8.40 V); the -B6S/MF (8.20 V) member under-charges 4.2 V cells and suits 4.1 V chemistries. Which is right for the Microduck's pack depends on the pack's cell (part:np-f550 unknowns).

logic.cite: STAT is an open-drain status OUTPUT and PROG is an analog programming pin; there is no logic input, so no VIH/VIL exists to transcribe.

pinout.$about: Pad number -> signal, DFN-10 3x3, read off the p.1 'Package Types (Top View)' figure; the layout extraction interleaves the figure with the Features column, so each quoted fragment is one pin pair of that figure.

DFN-10-3x3.EP: exposed thermal pad (pad 11 in the figure)

pinout.cite: datasheet.pdf p.1 'Package Types (Top View)', 'MCP73213 3x3 DFN *', '* Includes Exposed Thermal Pad (EP); see Table 3-1.'

unknowns: WHICH MEMBER (8.20 / 8.40 / 8.70 / 8.80 V) — depends on the pack's cell chemistry, which part:np-f550 cannot state.
The exposed pad's electrical potential (Table 3-1 not transcribed).
Charge-termination and timer details beyond 'Charge Termination ITERM/IREG 3.7 5 6.3 %' (p.6) and the p.2 '6 hr' timer column were not transcribed.

NO 5 V USB PATH: every limit is conditioned on VDD ≥ VREG + 0.3 V, so this linear part needs ≥ ~8.7 V in for an 8.40 V pack. The Microduck's USB-C is 5 V only with PD disabled (docs/ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE.md §9) — in-situ charging with this part would need a boost stage or a different topology (the LTC4002 switch-mode sheet saved under docs/ is a step-DOWN charger needing 8.9–22 V for its 8.4 V member, not a boost either).
WHETHER POLLEN'S PRODUCT CHARGES IN SITU AT ALL: CANNOT DETERMINE.
